title: Alchemy/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Fibonacci: "Heat, cold, toxin, and electricity; 'the elemental forces that create our universe'. To wield them, Papa invented the Crucibles, incredible devices capable of fusing these elements into the 'complex elemental forces'. Forces we require to complete Papa's vision. I have marked a Crucible. Go there now."

- Fibonacci: "Papa knew that the path to understanding this universe lay in mastering the elemental forces. So, Papa invented the Crucibles: alchemic devices for combining the simple elemental forces into complex forces. Through the Crucibles, Papa's work can live on."

- Fibonacci: "A Crucible. You must feed it the correct Amphors: capsules of elemental forces, compressed to a near impossible density. Volatile enough to be used as a grenade, should the need present itself. The problem? Our adversaries have taken Papa's Amphors. Be a dear and repatriate them."

- Fibonacci: "This Crucible requires feeding with the prescribed elemental forces. These can be found within the Amphors. Retrieve them from the Murmur and put them to use. Or, if emergency arises, hurl them at your assailants and observe the results. Stupid mineral things."
- Fibonacci: "Within this crucible, Heat and Cold birth a Blast force."
- Fibonacci: "Bring hot and cold together... It's a blast!"
- Fibonacci: "The Crucible creates Blast force. Gather Heat and Cold Amphors."
- Fibonacci: "To produce Corrosion, you'll require Amphors of Toxin and Electricity."
- Fibonacci: "Take Toxin and Electrical Amphors, mix well, and presto: Corrosion shall result."
- Fibonacci: "Corrosive force results from the interplay of electricity and toxicity."
- Fibonacci: "This Crucible creates Gas. Feed it Heat and Toxin Amphors."
- Fibonacci: "Gas elemental force, hm! Heat and Toxin Amphors required."
- Fibonacci: "Magnetic Crucible. The forces of electricity and extreme cold are required for this alchemy."
- Fibonacci: "A magnetic force can be created by electrical stimulation of an intensely cold subject."
- Fibonacci: "Unlike conventional science, Alchemy produces Magnetic energy by blending Cold and Electricity."
- Fibonacci: "A Radiation Crucible. Key Amphors are Heat and Electricity."
- Fibonacci: "This Crucible craves Heat and Electricity. Together they will yield Radiation."
- Fibonacci: "Combine Electricity with Heat to make Radiation."
- Fibonacci: "Viral elemental, hmm. You'll require Toxin and Cold Amphors."
- Fibonacci: "Papa's darkest Alchemic texts direct us to combine Cold with Toxin; a Viral elemental force shall surely result."
- Fibonacci: "Viral energy is extremely dangerous. Mingle your Toxin and Cold Amphors with caution."
- Fibonacci: "Don't just stand there! The Crucible requires the prescribed Amphors to work! Oh, bloody bipeds..."
- Fibonacci: "You must lob the correct Amphors toward the Crucible."
- Fibonacci: "Quickly now, throw the elemental Amphors at the Crucible. Well, go on!"
- Fibonacci: "Now for the Alchemy. Manage the venting system to keep pressure within the desired range."
- Fibonacci: "On your toes! We must keep the pressure in range."
- Fibonacci: "Crucible under pressure. Let's keep the system cooking, shall we?"
- Fibonacci: "Now the tricky part: pressure management. Stay limber, biped. You know, with your limbs!"

path: When Pressure is above Ideal range
lines: - Fibonacci: "Shoot the valve to release pressure."
- Fibonacci: "Should pressure exceed mandated tolerances, your work shall be for naught! Hit the release valve."
- Fibonacci: "The process will not succeed if pressure continues to rise. Open the release valve!"
- Fibonacci: "We have a new pressure target."
- Fibonacci: "Success! A new complex element has been created. Locating the next Crucible."
- Fibonacci: "Will you look at that, the purity... Do it again!"
- Fibonacci: "Shazam! What a gorgeous samp- who's a pretty sample? You are, you're a pretty sample, aren't you? Create another."
- Fibonacci: "Why... I do say. It's perfect. Make another."
- Fibonacci: "Ah, progress. But we require more. Again."
- Fibonacci: "Formidable progress! I urge you: keep the crucibles firing! Should opposition grow too great, of course, return home."
- Fibonacci: "Papa's vessels move one step closer to completion, huzzah! Should you feel the need to withdraw, the path to the Sanctum is open to you. Naturally."
- Fibonacci: "When need arises, you may return to the Sanctum. Until then, give the Murmur hell."
- Teshin: "A true Tenno understands how to combine the elements coursing through their Warframes. Prove yourself. Find a Crucible and the Amphors it needs to create a 'Complex Elemental Force.'"
- Teshin: "Crucibles: bizarre contraptions left behind from the time of Scholar's Landing. Master their alchemy to understand the elemental forces you wield. Locate a crucible."
- Teshin: "You found a Crucible. Now, liberate the necessary Amphors from your enemies."
- Teshin: "Your enemies hoard the Amphors the Crucibles need. Retrieve them."
- Teshin: "A Blast crucible. Mix Heat and Cold Amphors."
- Teshin: "When Heat and Cold crash together, the Blast elemental force is created."
- Teshin: "Mixing Amphors of Heat and Cold creates a Blast elemental force."
- Teshin: "Corrosion's elemental force is the deadly byproduct of Toxin and Electricity."
- Teshin: "This Crucible creates the Corrosive elemental force by mixing Toxin and Electricity."
- Teshin: "Combine Electricity and Toxin Amphors to produce the Corrosive elemental force."
- Teshin: "Hmmm... Gas crucible. Seek Heat and Toxin Amphors."
- Teshin: "Gas, the ephemeral elemental force, is created by combining Heat and Toxin."
- Teshin: "A Magnetic Crucible. Find Electricity and Cold Amphors."
- Teshin: "Cold and Electricity, these are the Amphors you seek."
- Teshin: "The forces of Heat and Electricity unleash Radiation when combined."
- Teshin: "Deadly Radiation, the product of Heat And Electricity Amphors."
- Teshin: "Marry Electricity and Heat Amphors to create Radiation."
- Teshin: "Toxin and Cold are the seeds of the Viral elemental force."
- Teshin: "Even in the Undercroft, Toxin and Cold create a Viral elemental force."
- Teshin: "Whether on your weapons or in the Crucible, Toxin and Cold Amphors will create a Viral elemental force."
- Teshin: "Cut the enemy forces down, take the Amphors, and hurl them at the Crucible."
- Teshin: "Throw the needed Amphors at the Crucible."
- Teshin: "Find an Amphor and throw it at the Crucible."
- Teshin: "Ah, a new element is born. Find the next Crucible."
- Teshin: "Finished. A new Crucible hungers for elements."
- Teshin: "You have birthed a complex elemental force. Create another."
- Teshin: "It is a comfort to know that even in the depths of the Undercroft, the laws of alchemical science remain unbroken."
- Teshin: "I imagine the long-departed Scholar would have been impressed with how you've wielded his Crucibles today."
- Teshin: "Good. Replicate these elemental combinations as you modify your weapons and Warframes."
- The Indifference/Rusalka: "If you came here to use Albrecht's Crucibles, the only thing you'll create... is a corpse. Yours."
- The Indifference/Rusalka: "Hmm. Albrecht's Crucibles. Crimes against the laws of nature. Do not think, for a second, that I will let you desecrate my kingdom with your element mixing!"
- The Indifference/Rusalka: "Ah, the Crucibles. One of Albrecht's many sins. Try and finish his work. See what happens to you."
- The Indifference/Rusalka: "You are playing with things you don't understand!"
- The Indifference/Rusalka: "You are really starting to bother me."
- The Indifference/Rusalka: "Enough of this playtime. Get. Out."
- The Indifference/Rusalka: "You only pollute this kingdom with these... "elements"."
- The Indifference/Rusalka: "You've made a MESS of those elements! A shameful mess."
